subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: Should the exact-head dependency relocation from qa-matrix into qa-lab be authorized for this migration stack?
rationale: Repository automation deliberately blocks resolved dependency graph changes until an authorized repository or security owner confirms that the ownership move and lockfile delta are intended.

options.title: Authorize this head
options.body: Approve after confirming qa-lab now owns Matrix scenario execution and the resolved graph only reflects that workspace dependency relocation.

options.title: Defer dependency ownership
options.body: Keep the dependencies in qa-matrix until its removal successor if the intermediate stack state should not transfer ownership yet.

recommendation.title: Authorize this head
recommendation.body: Approve after confirming qa-lab now owns Matrix scenario execution and the resolved graph only reflects that workspace dependency relocation.

likelyOwner.reason: They designed the stack and have the strongest relevant history for explaining the ownership move, although an authorized repository or security owner must grant the approval.
